concept_uz: Karvonsaroy hovlisi. Ota uch oʻgʻliga 17 ta tuya qoldirgan: yarmi, uchdan biri, toʻqqizdan biri. 17 hech qayoqqa boʻlinmaydi, aka-ukalar janjallashadi. Oʻz tuyasida keksa dono ayol keladi: «bir daqiqada hal qilaman» — va video shu savolda toʻxtaydi. Javob keyingi seshanba.

facts.claim: Savdogar uch oʻgʻliga 17 ta tuya qoldiradi: kattasiga yarmi, oʻrtanchaga uchdan biri, kenjaga toʻqqizdan biri
Shart: har bir oʻgʻil butun son tuya oladi, vaʼdadan kam emas, birorta tuyaga zarar yetmaydi
Keksa ayol oʻz tuyasida keladi va oʻsha tuyada uyiga qaytadi
Javob (keyingi haftaning videosi uchun): oʻrtancha oʻgʻil 6 ta tuya oladi; 18 ta tuya bilan 9 + 6 + 2 = 17
Jumboq 2026-10-05 da ochilgan (raund 1), javobi 2026-10-12 da ochiladi — javob videosi 2026-10-13 dan oldin emas

style_line: Cinematic photoreal, warm late-afternoon desert light, fine dust in the air, 35mm film look, sand, terracotta brick and faded turquoise tile tones, old Silk Road folk-tale mood. No text, no letters, no watermark.

refs.prompt: Vertical 9:16 wide shot of the courtyard of an old Bukhara-style caravanserai in late afternoon: a square sandy yard ringed by brick arcades, a turquoise-tiled arched gate, a stone well in the middle, about seventeen resting two-humped camels kneeling and standing around the yard with simple woven saddle blankets. No people.

Vertical 9:16 full-body portrait of an Uzbek man of about 30, tall and broad, short black beard, serious frowning face, DARK GREEN striped chapan robe with a wide leather belt, black-and-white doppi skullcap, holding a rolled paper scroll, standing in a sandy caravanserai yard.

Vertical 9:16 full-body portrait of a thin Uzbek man of about 25, clean-shaven, worried quick eyes, plain beige shirt and trousers with a bright RED scarf tied round his neck, counting on his fingers, standing in a sandy caravanserai yard.

Vertical 9:16 full-body portrait of an Uzbek teenage boy of about 16, cheeky grin, messy hair under a BLUE embroidered skullcap tilted to one side, white shirt with rolled sleeves, a small wooden flute tucked in his belt, standing in a sandy caravanserai yard.

Vertical 9:16 full-body shot of a wise elderly Uzbek woman of about 70 with a kind wrinkled face and bright eyes, a white headscarf and a long dark-blue velvet robe, sitting calmly on one pale cream-white two-humped camel whose bridle carries a row of RED wool tassels and one small brass bell, at the turquoise gate of a caravanserai.

Combine the attached images into one vertical 9:16 shot of the same caravanserai yard: the three brothers standing together by the well in the foreground arguing, the eldest holding the scroll, the camels resting all around them. Same faces, same clothes, same light.

Combine the attached images: the elderly woman on her cream-white camel with red tassels has just ridden in through the turquoise gate and stopped near the well; the three brothers turn toward her, surprised. Same faces, same clothes, same light, 9:16.

scenes.prompt: Fast push-in on the eldest brother as he snaps the scroll open with a loud paper crack and raises it high; a camel behind him groans loudly. Audio: paper snap, camel groan, wind. He declares proudly in Uzbek with a deep, firm young male voice of about 30: "Otamning vasiyati: tuyalarning yarmi — menga!". No subtitles, no on-screen text.

Quick comic two-shot by the well: the middle brother with the red scarf pushes forward pointing at his chest, then the youngest in the blue skullcap jumps in front of him, grinning. Audio: footsteps on sand, a camel snort. The middle brother says in Uzbek with a quick, nervous young male voice of about 25: "Uchdan biri — menga!" Then the youngest says in Uzbek with a bright, cheeky teenage boy voice of about 16: "To'qqizdan biri esa — menga!". No subtitles, no on-screen text.

The three brothers look around at the herd, counting with their fingers; the eldest freezes in disbelief, the youngest throws up his hands and laughs. Comic timing. Audio: murmured counting, a camel chewing. The eldest says in Uzbek with a deep, firm young male voice of about 30: "O'n yettining yarmi... sakkiz yarim?!" Then the youngest says, laughing in Uzbek with a bright, cheeky teenage boy voice of about 16: "Tuyani kesmaymiz-ku!". No subtitles, no on-screen text.

lines.text: Har biri butun tuya olsin, hech kim vasiyatdagidan kam olmasin — va birorta tuyaga zarar yetmasin.

scenes.prompt: Slow aerial drone shot rising over an empty sandy caravanserai courtyard with brick arcades at golden hour, long shadows, dust drifting. No people, no animals. Audio: wind, a faraway bell. An off-screen narrator says in Uzbek with a calm, warm middle-aged male storyteller voice: "Har biri butun tuya olsin, hech kim vasiyatdagidan kam olmasin — va birorta tuyaga zarar yetmasin.". No subtitles, no on-screen text.

The elderly woman rides slowly in through the turquoise gate on her cream-white camel, its red tassels swaying and its brass bell ringing; she stops and looks down at the brothers with a gentle, amused smile. Audio: one clear brass bell, soft hoof steps on sand. She says in Uzbek with a slow, warm, smiling elderly woman voice of about 70: "Bolalarim, nega janjal qilyapsizlar?". No subtitles, no on-screen text.

lines.text: Bir daqiqada hal qilaman. Keyin oʻz tuyamda uyimga qaytaman.

scenes.prompt: Medium close-up of the elderly woman still seated on her cream-white camel; she pats its neck, glances over the whole herd with knowing eyes, and gives the brothers a small confident nod. She does not get down. Audio: bell, a soft camel hum. She says in Uzbek with a slow, warm, smiling elderly woman voice of about 70: "Bir daqiqada hal qilaman. Keyin o'z tuyamda uyimga qaytaman.". No subtitles, no on-screen text.
